title: Page 9
content_zh:
巴瑞儿气到快抓狂，她人还在屋里，他居然敢和那女人窝在厕所里乱搞！
“掌尚仁，你给我出来！”气到指尖插入手臂，巴瑞儿强忍住想踹门的粗暴举动。
她未踹门，但门却砰的一声
“叫什么叫，烦死人了！”夏春静臭着，张脸出来，瞪了巴瑞儿一眼，便往厨房走去。
只有她？没看到掌尚仁出来，巴瑞儿探头进入厕所，也没见到他的人影，不死心，她进入东翻西找，想看看他是不是躲起来了。
找了找，什么都没有。
她一定是气疯了，掌尚仁那么大，只是，里头根本没有任何遮蔽物可以让他躲，再说，他又不是呆瓜，会在两颗未爆弹同处，室时，还脑残的“性”致勃勃，除非他想炸死自己。
所以，她被夏春静那女人耍了？
等等，方才她是不是看到什么东西？好像是……验孕棒？倏地回头，摆在马桶冲水箱上的，真的是验孕棒，而且上头有很明显的两条线！
虽然她没用过验孕棒，但她也知道验孕棒上出现两条线就代表——怀孕了。呆望着验孕棒，巴瑞儿感觉一阵青天霹雳。夏春静怀孕了？她……她怀了尚仁的孩子？
不！不可能，尚仁说过，在结婚前，他不会让任何女人“不小心”怀孕，他一向都有做好避孕措施，他说，这是基于爱护女人应该做的事。
夏春静该不会是和那个小男朋友……
不让自己胡思乱猜，直接问她不是比较快。
深吸，口气，巴瑞儿走向蔚房，强装冷静。
“夏春静，你……”呆住了，那女人竟然把她放在冰箱里特地要“招待”掌尚仁的酸辣虾汤，拿出来吃。
“我心情不好，别烦我！”夏春静有气无力的说，虾子一只只送进嘴里。
“你……”不辣吗？管她辣不辣，当务之急，就是要先确定她肚里孩子的爹是谁。“你怀孕了？”
“要你管！”夏春静烦躁的丢掉虾头，直接用手再捞一只。
“我并不想管你的事，我只想知道……孩子是谁的？”冷静、冷静，一定要冷静，巴瑞儿在心中祈祷，绝对不要是尚仁的。
“你会不会管太多了？你……”夏春静不耐烦地吼，见到巴瑞儿强装冷静的表情，她的态度忽地转换，洋洋得意了起来。“你一定很呕吧？我现在怀了尚仁哥的孩子，马上就变成正宫娘娘，而你这个即将被打入冷宫的女人，识相的就快滚吧！”

“你确定……孩子是尚仁的？”
“那当然，不然会是谁的？”
“你，不是才和那个小男生分手？”她不是故意想伤她，只是她确实同时和两个男人交往，她只是希望她能确定一下，何况尚仁，向都有做好避孕措施，她肚里孩子的爹是尚仁这个可能性不大。
“我和他根本没做过！”夏春静大吼，旋即觉得自己干么跟一个心机重的女人说这么多。“反正我怀孕了，所以你出局，快滚吧你！”
巴瑞儿被她的话惊愣住，那句话她很自然地大声脱口而出，应该不是在说谎，如果她真的没和那个小男生发生过关系，那她肚里孩的爹，不就是……尚仁？
这就是她一再说服自己，坚持等到最后的答案？
可笑的是，前一分钟她还抱着希望，希望她说孩子不是尚仁的，如此，她就可以和尚仁继续走下去。
她巴瑞儿怎会变成这样一个委曲求全的人，早在得知夏春静的事后，她就该狠揍尚仁几拳，潇洒离开，这才是她呀！
现在离开，也不算太迟就是。她只能这么自我安慰着。
落寞的想离开，突然那女人大叫一声，吓得她往后退一步。
“喔，好痛喔……”夏春静双手捧着肚子，一张脸痛得扭曲。
“你怎么了？”巴瑞儿惊得倒抽一口气，该不会是吃得太辣，辣到肚里胎儿承受不了……会不会流产？
被夏春静痛苦的表情吓住，巴瑞儿没办法思考其他事，一心担忧她会不会因此流产，虽然她不希望她怀的是尚仁的孩子，可是也没恶劣的想要她流产。
“你这个……坏心的女人，煮这个给我吃，你是不是想害我流产……痛死我了啦！”
有没有搞清楚，明明是她自己去冰箱拿这锅虾汤出来吃的，还诬赖她！
算了，她不想计较这些，先叫救护车送她到医院要紧。
“你忍耐一下，我马上叫救护车。”
“快点……好痛……痛死我了！”
第10章(2)
拿着缝针，神情恍惚的巴瑞儿在水煮蛋上用针写出“掌尚仁”三个字，回神，发现自己又在想他，瞪了无辜的水煮蛋一眼，张开嘴，她狠狠地咬了一大口。

前天下午，她送夏春静到医院，医生检查过后，说那女人是胃溃疡，吃得太辣胃痛，至于肚里的小胚胎一切安好，没有受到影响，但是医生强烈建议她不要再吃辣。
夏小姐想不想再吃辣，她可不想管，也管不了，孩子的爹自然会去关心她。
她打电话到公司，是左金接的，她要他转达掌尚仁，告诉他夏春静在医院吊点滴，请他自行处里，她不想再当傻子陪人家孩子的娘。
确定夏春静平安无事后，她便离开医院，回到豪宅公寓把自己的行李收一收，投奔到大姊家暂住。
算一算，已经过两天了，将近快五十个小时，他居然连一通道歉的电话也没打来，虽然她已下定决心要和他分手，但他……好歹也该为他所做的事向她道个歉，可没有，一通电话都没有！
这男人怎么会这么没担当？亏他还是堂堂大总裁！
“瑞儿，我们出去走走，好不好？”大姊坐到她身边，兴致勃勃的提议。“大姊，你可以吗？”
“我现在害喜症状减轻许多，而且有你陪我，我想出去散散步，好吗？”
“呃……当然好。”虽然她一点都不想出门，但大姊自从怀孕后很少出门，大姊夫平常又要上班，也没太多时间陪大姊散步，现在有她在，大姊有个伴，出门也安心得多。
“那走吧！”
“大姊，你想去哪里？”
“之前你大姊夫提过你和总裁老板……呃，你们常去一家咖啡店喝康宝蓝，你大姊夫有说过要带我去，可是他现在在上班，休假时我们又都得回婆家，一直没机会去喝……”
听着大姊的愿望，巴瑞儿忍不住在心中哀嚎。她现在最不想的就是去任何和掌尚仁有关的地方，大姊的这个心愿，无疑是拿针往她心脏刺。
“大姊，要喝康宝蓝，其他咖啡店也有，我们……”
“可是‘他’跟你姊夫说，那家咖啡店的康宝蓝是他喝过最好喝的……”大姊越说越小声。“如果你不想去，那……那等改天你大姊夫有空，我再和他一起去好了。”
“我无所谓。”苦笑。“可是大姊你现在怀孕，喝咖啡好吗？医生说孕妇最好不要吃喝太剌激、太辣的食物，像咖啡，还有……”
心脏又被针刺痛好几下，这个“医生说”，是她送夏春静到医院，医生叮咛的事。想到他让夏春静怀了他的孩子，彻底毁了他们俩的爱情，她的心就一阵揪疼。
“偶尔一次没关系的。瑞儿，我们快走，不然会来不及。”
“来不及？现在才几点，咖啡店没那么早打烊。”
“我是说……也许你姊夫今天会提早回家。”

“喔。”
巴瑞儿觉得奇怪，大姊平常不喝咖啡的，为何突然想喝，还一副迫不及待大概是每天关在家里，闷到慌，可以出门当然高兴喽！
content_en:
Barrier was so angry that he almost went crazy. She was still in the house, but he actually dared to have sex with that woman in the toilet!
"Zhang Shangren, come out!" Barrier was so angry that her fingertips dug into her arms, and she resisted the violent move of wanting to kick the door.
She didn't kick the door, but there was a bang
"What's it called? It's so annoying!" Xia Chunjing came out with a stinking face, glared at Barry, and walked to the kitchen.
Just her? Not seeing Zhang Shangren come out, Barrier looked into the toilet and saw no trace of him. Unwilling to give up, she went in and looked around to see if he was hiding.
I searched, but found nothing.
She must have been mad because her palm was so big, but there was no shelter for him to hide inside. Besides, he was not an idiot. He would get sexually excited when two unexploded bombs were in the same room, unless he wanted to blow himself up.
So, she was tricked by that woman Xia Chunjing?
Wait, did she see something just now? It seems like... a pregnancy test? I turned around quickly and saw that what was placed on the toilet flush tank was really a pregnancy test stick, and there were two very obvious lines on it!
Although she had never used a pregnancy test stick, she also knew that two lines on the pregnancy test stick meant she was pregnant. Looking at the pregnancy test stick blankly, Barry felt like a thunderbolt from the sky. Xia Chunjing is pregnant? She...she's pregnant with Shang Ren's child?
No! Impossible. Shangren said that before getting married, he would not let any woman get pregnant "accidentally". He had always taken contraceptive measures. He said that this was what he should do out of love for women.
Could it be that Xia Chunjing is with that little boyfriend...
It would be quicker to stop making wild guesses and ask her directly.
Taking a deep breath, Barrier walked towards Wei Fang, pretending to be calm.
"Xia Chunjing, you..." She was stunned. The woman actually put her in the refrigerator to "treat" Zhang Shangren's hot and sour shrimp soup and take it out to eat.
"I'm in a bad mood, don't bother me!" Xia Chunjing said weakly, putting the shrimps into her mouth one by one.
"You..." Isn't it spicy? Regardless of whether she is hot or not, the first priority is to determine who the father of the child in her belly is. "Are you pregnant?"
"I want you to take care of it!" Xia Chunjing threw away the shrimp head irritably and fished out another one with her hands.
"I don't want to interfere with your business, I just want to know...whose child is it?" Calm down, calm down, must be calm, Barrier prayed in her heart, it must not be Shang Ren's.
"Are you taking too much care? You..." Xia Chunjing yelled impatiently. Seeing Barrier's forced calm expression, her attitude suddenly changed and she became smug. "You must be disgusting, right? Now that I am pregnant with Brother Shang Ren's child, I will soon become the empress of the palace, and you, a woman who is about to be relegated to the cold palace, get out of here if you are sensible!"
"Are you sure... the child is Shang Ren's?"
"Of course, otherwise who would it be?"
"Didn't you just break up with that little boy?" She didn't mean to hurt her, but she was indeed dating two men at the same time. She just hoped that she could be sure. Besides, Shangren and Xiang had taken contraceptive measures. It was unlikely that the father of the child in her belly was Shangren.
"He and I have never done anything!" Xia Chunjing yelled, and immediately felt why she was talking so much to a scheming woman. "Anyway, I'm pregnant, so you're out, get out of here!"
Barrier was stunned by her words. She blurted out those words naturally and loudly. She probably wasn't lying. If she really didn't have sex with that little boy, then wouldn't the father of her baby be... Shang Ren?
Is this the answer she has repeatedly convinced herself to wait until the end?
What's ridiculous is that one minute she was still holding out hope that she would say that the child was not Shang Ren's, so that she could continue to walk with Shang Ren.
How could she, Barrier, become such a submissive person? She should have punched Shang Ren a few times after learning about Xia Chunjing., left gracefully, this is her!
It's not too late to leave now. She could only comfort herself like this.
Lonely, she wanted to leave, but suddenly the woman yelled, scaring her to take a step back.
"Oh, it hurts..." Xia Chunjing held her stomach with both hands, her face twisted in pain.
"What's wrong with you?" Barrier gasped in shock. Could it be that the food was too spicy and the fetus in her belly couldn't bear it... Could it be a miscarriage?
Frightened by Xia Chunjing's painful expression, Barrier couldn't think about anything else. She was worried about whether she would have a miscarriage. Although she didn't want her to be pregnant with Shang Ren's child, she didn't want her to miscarry badly.
"You... evil-hearted woman, cook this for me. Do you want to cause me to have a miscarriage... It hurts me to death!"
Have you figured it out? She obviously went to the refrigerator to get the pot of shrimp soup and ate it, and yet she was falsely accused!
Forget it, she didn't want to worry about it. It was important to call an ambulance to take her to the hospital first.
"Be patient, I'll call an ambulance right away."
"Hurry up...it hurts...it hurts me to death!"
Chapter 10(2)
Holding a needle, Barrier, who was in a daze, used a needle to write the words "Zhang Shangren" on the boiled egg. When she came to her senses, she found that she was thinking about him again. She glared at the innocent boiled egg, opened her mouth, and took a big bite.
The afternoon before yesterday, she sent Xia Chunjing to the hospital. After examination, the doctor said that the woman had a gastric ulcer and suffered stomach pain from eating too much spicy food. As for the little embryo in her belly, everything was fine and not affected, but the doctor strongly advised her not to eat spicy food anymore.
She doesn't want to care about whether Miss Xia wants to eat spicy food again, and she can't care about it. The child's father will naturally care about her.
She called the company and was answered by Zuo Jin. She asked him to convey to Zhang Shangren that Xia Chunjing was on an intravenous drip in the hospital and asked him to handle the situation on his own. She no longer wanted to be a fool to accompany other people's children.
After confirming that Xia Chunjing was safe and sound, she left the hospital, returned to the luxury apartment to pack her luggage, and went to live with her elder sister temporarily.
After all, it has been two days, almost fifty hours, and he has not even called to apologize. Although she has made up her mind to break up with him, he... should at least apologize to her for what he has done, but no, not a single phone call!
How could this man be so irresponsible? Fortunately, he is still a great CEO!
"Rui'er, let's go for a walk, shall we?" the eldest sister sat next to her and suggested enthusiastically. "Sister, can you do it?"
"My symptoms of euphoria are much relieved now, and you are with me. I want to go for a walk, okay?"
"Uh... of course." Although she didn't want to go out at all, her eldest sister rarely went out since she was pregnant. Her eldest brother-in-law usually had to go to work and didn't have much time to walk with her. Now that she is here, her eldest sister has a companion, so she feels much more at ease when going out.
"Then let's go!"
"Sister, where do you want to go?"
"Your eldest brother-in-law mentioned before that you and the CEO boss...well, you often go to a coffee shop to drink Herbalife. Your eldest brother-in-law has said that he would take me there, but he is at work now, and we have to go back to my in-laws' house during vacation, so we have never had the chance to drink..."
Listening to her eldest sister's wish, Barrier couldn't help but wailed in her heart. The last thing she wants to do now is to go to any place related to Zhang Shangren. This wish of the eldest sister is undoubtedly to stab her heart with a needle.
"Sister, I want to drink Herbalife. Other coffee shops also have it. We..."
"But 'he' told your brother-in-law that the Herbalife in that coffee shop is the best he has ever tasted..." The eldest sister said softer and softer. "If you don't want to go, then...then wait until your elder brother-in-law is free another day, and I will go with him."
"I don't care." He smiled bitterly. "But sister, you are pregnant now, is it okay to drink coffee? The doctor said that pregnant women should not eat or drink foods that are too stimulating or spicy, such as coffee, and..."
The heart is stung by the needle againSeveral times, this "doctor said" was what the doctor told her to do when she sent Xia Chunjing to the hospital. Her heart ached when she thought that he had made Xia Chunjing pregnant with his child and completely ruined their love.
"It doesn't matter once in a while. Rui'er, let's go quickly, otherwise we won't be able to make it in time."
"Not in time? It's only what time it is, the coffee shop doesn't close that early."
"I mean... maybe your brother-in-law will come home early today."
"Oh."
Barrier found it strange that her eldest sister, who usually doesn't drink coffee, suddenly wanted to drink it and couldn't wait to drink it. She was probably cooped up at home every day and was bored. Of course she was happy to be able to go out!
